tools.name: run_readiness_planner
tools.description: Evaluates a custom-home or major-remodel project across six readiness dimensions and returns a personalized Project Readiness Brief. Accepts normalized assessment answers (q1-q24) and returns the likely project pathway, what appears aligned vs. what needs attention, property/site risk considerations

tools.name: get_readiness_planner_meta
tools.description: Returns metadata describing the readiness planner: its purpose, the assessment sections, the seven possible pathways, the six readiness dimensions, expected completion time, and the educational-use disclaimer.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Returns approved public business information for Cosmopolitan Company: name, website, phone, email, address, description, and service areas across the Oklahoma City metro.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_info · Private data: run_readiness_planner · Public sink: get_business_info · Destructive: run_readiness_planner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_info · Private data: run_readiness_planner · Public sink: get_business_info · Destructive: run_readiness_planner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
